today.title: Today
today.onPlanSub: Spend up to this today and the week stays on track.
today.adjustedSub: Earlier spending was higher, so today's amount is spread lower.
today.attentionSub: Today's amount is used. Tomorrow starts fresh.
today.periodExceededSub: This week's flexible money is used. Protected money is untouched.
today.daysLeft: {count, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}}
today.todayStartsAt: Today starts at (lower of the two)
today.underspendNote: Under-spending isn't added to tomorrow; it stays in your weekly remainder for review.
today.noActivity: Nothing yet. Tap a quick-add above when you spend.
today.protectedNote: Set aside in your plan. Not touched by daily spending.

check.title: Check a purchase
check.subtitle: See the effect before you buy. Nothing is recorded until you add it.

plan.title: Plan
plan.futureFundHint: Savings goal. Recorded in your plan only — no real money moves.
plan.monthlyIncomeHint: Used only for the optional work-time view in Check.
plan.lockedNote: These amounts are kept out of daily spending.
plan.chooseStrategyDesc: Select a mathematically balanced starting allocation scaled to your declared {income}/mo income.
plan.autoRebalanceDesc: Scale all 4 envelopes proportionally to fit your declared {income}/mo income.
plan.rebalancedWithEmergencyToast: Plan rebalanced to {income}/mo · {emergency} emergency relief preserved

waitList.title: Wait list
waitList.emptyDesc: When checking a purchase, choose “Wait 24 hours” to cool down impulse buys and reflect before you spend.

activity.title: Activity
activity.emptyRecordedDesc: Use Quick Add on Today or Check Purchase to log your first spend.
activity.emptyFilterDesc: Try resetting your filter to view all recorded transactions.

progress.title: Progress
progress.heroSub: You have stayed within your daily pace without pulling from protected commitments.
progress.m1Desc: Locked Home and Future Funds untouched for 30 consecutive days.
progress.m2Desc: Successfully waited 24 hours on 5 impulse purchase checks.
progress.m3Desc: Completed 4 consecutive weekly reviews and allocated surplus.
progress.leagueDisclaimer: No dollar amounts or personal transactions are ever shared. Participation is based strictly on your pace percentage consistency.

emergency.title: Emergency Fund Access
emergency.subtitle: This transfers money from your protected commitments into daily essentials and logs an immutable audit event.
emergency.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Urgent medical prescription or emergency repair
emergency.activeBannerDesc: {amount} was unlocked from protected funds for essentials this cycle.
emergency.replenishNote: Base recurring envelopes will remain balanced when rebalancing.
emergency.detailsSubtitle: Audit records of protected funds unlocked into essentials for this cycle.
emergency.noAccessHistory: No emergency funds have been accessed this cycle.
emergency.returnToVaultDesc: Return this money back into your protected vault and deduct it from active essentials.
emergency.clearAllEmergencyToast: All emergency relief cleared and {amount} restored to Protected Vault
emergency.vaultDepleted: Emergency Vault Depleted for this Cycle

review.title: Weekly review
review.daysToGo: {count, plural, one {# day still to go — the remainder may change.} other {# days still to go — the remainder may change.}}
review.lastDay: This is the last day of the week.
review.question: What should happen to {amount}?
review.allocateFuture: Allocate in plan to Future fund
review.allocateFutureDesc: Adds the remainder to your Future fund total.
review.carryNextDesc: Keeps it as flexible money next period.
review.leaveUnchangedDesc: Keeps flexible envelopes as they are.
review.disclaimer: SaveLuy records your plan. It doesn't move real money.
review.weekBalancedDesc: Your decisions have been locked into your plan. Tomorrow starts with a fresh daily pace.
review.futureToast: {amount} allocated in plan to Future fund
review.carryToast: Remainder will carry into next week

auth.headline: Clarity Before You Spend.
auth.subheadline: One dependable daily number. Keep your rent, bills, and future savings safely protected.
auth.securityBadge: Private & encrypted · Zero ads · No debt tracking

settings.title: Settings
settings.guestDesc: Sign in with Google to synchronize your plan and transactions across devices.
settings.exchangeRateDesc: Set the exchange rate used for converting values when viewing or entering Khmer Riel (៛). Default market standard is 4,000 ៛ = $1 USD.
settings.cycleAnchorDesc: Choose when your weekly safe-to-spend cycle resets to match your payday or work schedule.
settings.voiceDesc: Choose how purchase check feedback and warnings are phrased.
settings.p1Desc: We don't build around retroactive pie charts. We give you one dependable number today.
settings.p2Desc: Rent, bills, and future goals never get commingled with flexible daily funds.
settings.p3Desc: Seeing the mathematical ripple effect before tapping the card prevents mid-week surprises.
settings.resetDesc: Clear all local simulation data and restore default starter state.
